visual_action: A slideshow of two photographs. The first shows Donald Trump sitting at a dinner table, smiling with his chin resting on his hand. The second is a photograph of a younger Donald Trump standing next to Jeffrey Epstein; both are smiling for the camera.

cast.name: Donald Trump
cast.evidence: Donald Trump is visually identifiable in both photographs presented in the video.

cast.name: Jeffrey Epstein
cast.evidence: Jeffrey Epstein is visually identifiable in the second photograph, standing next to Donald Trump.

on_screen_text.text:
climbed a mountain
and i turned around

spoken_summary: A female vocalist sings lyrics from the Fleetwood Mac song 'Landslide'. The relevant sung lyrics are, 'I climbed a mountain and I turned around... And I saw my reflection...'. The on-screen text changes the sung lyric 'my reflection' to 'our reflection'.
audio_music: The song 'Landslide' by Fleetwood Mac plays throughout the video. It has a gentle, acoustic, and melancholic tone which creates an ironic mood when paired with the visuals.
editing_pacing: A slow-paced slideshow consisting of two still photographs that change in time with the song lyrics.
central_claim: Donald Trump's past association with Jeffrey Epstein is a damning reflection of his character.
intended_effect: To create a strong negative association between Donald Trump and Jeffrey Epstein in the viewer's mind, fostering distrust and disgust.
